mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as a 2% y-o-y drop in the INDPRO index, signals a supply-side contraction that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth falls by > 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall by > 10% y-o-y and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST y-o-y growth < -10% and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by > 1% y-o-y and the unemployment rate is above 6%, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% y-o-y and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth accelerating by > 3% y-o-y and falling unemployment rate signal a strong economic expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 y-o-y growth > 3% and UNRATE falling but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
